t: Passenger Train Derails in Pakistan, Kills Four, Injures 30 — Reports
d: At least four people were killed and 30 injured after a passenger train derailed in Sher Shah, Punjab province, Associated Press reported.

t: Trump Pressures Zelensky to Seek Peace, Defends Diesel Deal With Russia
d: US President Donald Trump stepped up pressure on Zelensky to reach an agreement with Russia, arguing that President Vladimir Putin is currently more interested in making a deal than Zelensky.

t: DPRK Tests Upgraded Tactical Ballistic Missile
d: North Korea’s Missile Administration test-fired a tactical ballistic missile on October 12 to verify the successful technical upgrade of a key core component, KCNA reported.

t: Russia Tops Medal Table at World Skate Games
d: Russia's roller sports team has won 17 medals — including 7 golds — in the first week of the World Skate Games in Asuncion, Paraguay.

t: FSB Shuts Down Ukrainian Drone Plot Targeting Voronezh Military Airfield

d: Russian forces from Battlegroyp Tsentr liberated 286 buildings in Dobropolye over the past 24 hours, including three industrial facilities, and eliminated up to 65 Ukrainian troops, the Russian Defense Ministry reported on Tuesday.

t: Russian Strategic Partnership With ASEAN Remains Top Priority - Lavrov
d: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said that strengthening Russia's strategic partnership with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) remains an unwavering priority.

t: Russia-US Diesel Fuel Deal Meets Interests of Both Countries - Kremlin

t: Putin Holds Telephone Conversation With President of UAE - Kremlin
d: Russian President Vladimir Putin held a telephone conversation with UAE President Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the Kremlin said on Tuesday.

t: US Pressure on Zelensky Exposes Its Iron Grip on Ukraine – Analyst
